results.description: This is a step-by-step visual DIY tutorial for making a rustic wooden Christmas tree collar, presented as a photo collage with a finished result and a gray cat. The top image shows the completed project in use: a small flocked artificial Christmas tree decorated with rose-gold matte baubles and warm white string lights sits on a flared wooden collar made of vertical light-brown slats between two circular hoops, placed on a white surface beside a dark gray short-haired cat looking upward. Below, the collage breaks the build into six stages. In the upper left, a thin wooden hoop rests on a wood tabletop with fine white sawdust scattered nearby, indicating sanding. Upper right shows light-colored wooden sticks or slats next to blue-handled scissors on a wooden surface, suggesting cutting to size. Middle left displays the early assembly: two hoops stacked vertically on a multicolored checkered floor with several slats attached between them forming a partial skirt. Middle right shows the same slatted structure fully encircled, now a complete open-ended cylinder, resting on light carpet. Lower left captures a hand using a paintbrush to apply a dark brown wood stain to the exterior slats, with a small container of stain visible. Lower right shows the finished stained collar, the vertical slats now a warm medium brown, sitting on cardboard ready for use.
